reasons: Baseline: the game as merged at a02dac2 (Sprint 001 port plus Sprint 002 car id, name and car switch); replaces the v24 trace comparison.
S002-T5: S15 2nd gear 1.902 -> 2.1 for more pull at low rpm (manual-shift, straight-accel and wobble use 2nd; Daniel feel-checks it).

S002-T10: skill setting and steering wobble removed (grip fixed at the old skill-0.4 value, bit-identical to the old run with zero wobble); every state hash changes because the car has no wobble value and no random number is drawn per tick.
S002-T10 braking (state, line): no wobble, so the car ends 0.06 m and 0.7 deg of heading away from before; stop distance and speeds unchanged.
S002-T10 drift-countersteer (state, line): no wobble, so the open-loop drift ends 0.9 m away with 66.3 instead of 65.9 deg peak slip; still one drift, no spin.
S002-T10 manual-shift (state, line): no wobble, so the car ends 0.03 m and 0.1 deg of heading away; shifts and speed unchanged.
S002-T10 steady-corner (state, line): no wobble, so the car ends 0.3 m along its circle from before; speed and yaw rate unchanged.
S002-T10 straight-accel (state, line): no wobble, so the car ends 0.4 m and 0.5 deg of heading away; acceleration and shifts unchanged.
S002-T10 wobble (state, line): this straight-line scenario now runs dead straight (it was 1.6 m off line from the wobble alone); the name is kept for the v24 file.
S003-T3 braking: rear brake capped at 75% of rear grip (rearBrakeMaxShare, Daniel option 1B) so braking while turning no longer spins; straight stops 3-5% longer.
S003-T3 drift-countersteer: rear cornering grip +5% (rearCornerGrip 1.05, Daniel option 2B) so a lift at the limit no longer spins; the recorded drift now runs differently.
S003-T3 steady-corner: rear cornering grip +5% (rearCornerGrip 1.05, Daniel option 2B) changes the cornering balance; the other three scenarios keep their hashes.

S004-T2 drift-countersteer (state, line): steering now stays where it is put with a speed-dependent rate (no self-centring), so the recorded taps leave full lock on; the car ends stopped after two drifts instead of rolling at 35 km/h after one (both runs reach spin mode).

S004-T2 steady-corner (state, line): the recorded on/off taps relied on self-centring to hold about a quarter lock; with held steering they add up to full lock, so the car ends in a tight 10 km/h circle instead of a 43 km/h corner. The other four scenarios never steer and keep their hashes.
